def.brief: Build build.py (and docs/assets/ it writes) so that every sentence of Q-build, Q-post, Q-feed, Q-time and Q-ui is true and tests/test_s1.py passes. Standard library only. Do not change the tests. Do not create content/ posts beyond what the tests make in their temporary directories. A build.py from an earlier attempt (s1-build, dropped only because of a test fixture since fixed) is already in the tree: check it against the contract, finish or correct it.
